relationships.subject: ZD7288
relationships.evidence_quote: Microinjection of ZD7288 and ZIP improved pain-escape and anxiety-like behaviors.

relationships.subject: Voluntary running exercise
relationships.evidence_quote: Voluntary running exercise induced pre- and post-LTP and improved these behaviors in knee OA mice.

key_findings: ACC neurons of knee OA mice show absent LTP induction and ZD7288/ZIP-sensitive pre-existing plasticity; ACC microinjection of ZD7288 and ZIP improved pain-escape and anxiety-like behaviors.
